rulebook: Minimum Licensing Requirements for Out-of-School Time Facilities (PDF)

items.requirement: Owners, operators, staff, therapists, and volunteers are mandated reporters and must call Hotline if suspect maltreatment.
items.quote: Owners, operators, staff, therapists, and volunteers are mandated reporters of suspected child maltreatment and are required to call the Child Maltreatment Hotline at 1-800-482-5964, if they have reason to suspect child maltreatment.

items.requirement: The facility must have a written procedure for reporting suspected child maltreatment and call the Hotline whenever there is suspicion.
items.quote: The facility shall provide a written procedure for reporting suspected of child maltreatment. This procedure shall be followed, and a call made to the Hotline whenever there is a suspicion of child maltreatment (1-800-482-5964).

items.requirement: The facility must have a written procedure for reporting suspected licensing violations, including serious violations.
items.quote: The facility shall provide a written procedure for reporting suspected licensing violations. Serious licensing violations shall be reported to the Licensing Unit.

items.requirement: Parents must be informed in writing upon enrollment that participants may be interviewed by licensing staff, investigators, or law enforcement.
items.quote: Parents shall be informed in writing upon enrollment of their child that participants may be subject to interviews by licensing staff, child maltreatment investigators, or law enforcement officials

items.requirement: The staff-to-participant ratio for kindergarten and above is one staff member for 18 participants.
items.quote: a. Kindergarten and above Number of Staff 1 Number of Children 18

items.requirement: Second grade and above may take short-term activities not within sight or hearing if accompanied by another participant and monitored.
items.quote: Out-of-School Time (OST) participants, second grade and above, may be provided opportunities to take part in short-term activities not within the sight and hearing of OST staff.

items.requirement: Group size is limited to two times the number of children allowed with one staff member.
items.quote: Group size shall be limited to two (2) times the number of children allowed with one (1) staff member.

items.requirement: A written weekly routine of developmentally appropriate activities must be provided to parents at enrollment.
items.quote: The Out-of-School Time (OST) Program shall develop a written weekly routine listing developmentally appropriate activities for participants and provide a copy of the routine of weekly activities to parents when they enroll the participants.

items.requirement: Written parental permission is required when a school-age participant leaves the program for another activity.
items.quote: School age participants who leave the OST Program to participate in other activities shall have written permission from the parents naming the activity, date, time of leaving and returning, and method of transportation.

items.requirement: Parents must not be denied access to their child at any time during hours of operation.
items.quote: Parents shall not be denied access to their child and youth at any time during hours of operation.

items.requirement: Written parental permission is required before photos or video recordings are made of a participant.
items.quote: Photos or video recordings shall not be made of any participant without prior written permission from the parent or guardian.

items.requirement: Written parental permission is required before placing participant photos or videos on social media or websites.
items.quote: Photos or video recordings of participants shall not be placed on social media or other websites without prior written parental permission.

items.requirement: Staff must not release a participant to anyone not immediately recognized as parent or authorized pickup unless ID is verified.
items.quote: Staff shall not release a participant to anyone who is not immediately recognized as the participant’s parent or as someone on the authorized pick-up list unless: a. The individual can provide an official picture identification (ID) and; b. The person in charge can match the ID

items.requirement: Full-time programs must provide at least one hour of outdoor activity daily in suitable weather; part-day programs at least 30 minutes.
items.quote: For full time programs, there shall be a total of at least one (1) hour of outdoor activity time per day in suitable weather. For programs operating part day schedules (five (5) hours per day or less) a minimum of thirty (30) minutes

items.requirement: Written parental permission must be on file for each field trip.
items.quote: Written permission from parents shall be on file for each field trip.

items.requirement: No more than 25% of total weekly program hours may allow recreational electronic media use.
items.quote: no more than twenty-five percent (25%) of the program’s total weekly program hours of operation allow participants to engage or use electronic media solely for recreational purposes.

items.requirement: Field trip ratios must be adjusted to 1:9 depending on risk or supervision needs.
items.quote: Ratios shall be adjusted to a 1:9 depending on the risk associated with the field trip activity or to maintain proper supervision of all participants in attendance on the field trip.

items.requirement: Behavior guidance practices must be discussed with parents at enrollment, provided in writing, and receipt verified in writing.
items.quote: Discuss the behavior guidance practices of the OST Program with the parents of each participant at the time of enrollment;

items.requirement: Parents must be advised in writing that licensing compliance forms are available for review upon request.
items.quote: The facility shall advise parents in writing that the compliance forms are available for review upon request.

items.requirement: Unacceptable behavior guidance measures include physical punishment, mechanical restraint, isolation without supervision, shaming, denying food, and others listed.
items.quote: The following activities or threats of such activities are unacceptable as behavior guidance measures and shall not be used for participants. These include, but are not limited to the following:

items.requirement: Each participant record must contain an authorized record of up-to-date immunizations or exemption documentation.
items.quote: An authorized record of up-to-date immunizations or documentation of a religious, medical, or philosophical exemption from the Arkansas Department of Health (ADH).

items.requirement: During all-day operations, lunch and mid-morning and mid-afternoon snacks must be served to each participant.
items.quote: The Out-of-School Time (OST) Program shall ensure that during all day program operations a lunch and a mid-morning and mid-afternoon snack is served to each participant.

items.requirement: Milk must be served to each participant during the day, except allergy substitutions with written instructions.
items.quote: Milk shall be served to each participant during the day. Exceptions may be made for participants who suffer allergies to milk. The facility shall obtain written instructions for allergy substitutions.

items.requirement: Indoor activities require 25 square feet per participant of usable floor space, excluding bathrooms, kitchen, hallways.
items.quote: Twenty-five (25) square feet per participant of usable floor space shall be required for indoor activities. This does not include bathrooms, kitchen, and hallways.

items.requirement: Play area must provide at least 75 square feet per child present.
items.quote: The play area and outdoor learning area shall be fenced or otherwise enclosed and provide at least seventy-five (75) square feet per child present on the playground at any time.

items.requirement: Trampolines shall not be used, except therapeutic one-on-one supervised use.
items.quote: Trampolines shall not be used. (Therapeutic use of trampolines is acceptable if supervised by the therapist on a one-on-one basis.)

items.requirement: Wading pools shall not be used; sprinklers and water play are not prohibited.
items.quote: Wading pools shall not be used. This does not prohibit the use of sprinklers and water play.

items.requirement: Participants must wear properly fitted approved helmets while riding bicycles, skates, skateboards, roller blades, and scooters.
items.quote: All participants shall wear properly fitted and approved helmets while riding on bicycles and when using roller skates, skate boards, roller blades, and scooters.

items.requirement: Each participant in care during rest time must have labeled individual cot or mat, bottom sheet, and adequate cover.
items.quote: There shall be a labeled individual cot or mat, bottom sheet, and adequate cover for each participant in care during rest time.

items.requirement: Participants with listed contagious or infectious symptoms or diseases must be temporarily excluded from care.
items.quote: The caregiver shall temporarily exclude the participant from care if the participant has:

items.requirement: Sleeping equipment must be kept at least one foot apart.
items.quote: All sleeping equipment shall be kept at least one foot (1') apart to prevent cross-contamination and ease of access in an emergency.

items.requirement: Medication may be given only with signed parental permission including date, type, drug name, time, dosage, length, and purpose.
items.quote: Medication shall be given to participants only with signed parental permission which includes date, type, drug name, time, and dosage, length of time to give medication, and what the medication is being given for.

items.requirement: Injuries requiring medical attention must be reported to parent immediately and to Licensing Unit within one business day.
items.quote: Injuries that require the attention of medical personnel shall be reported to the parent immediately and to the Licensing Unit within one (1) business day.

items.requirement: Parents or guardians of all participants must be notified of contagious illness as soon as possible.
items.quote: Parents or guardians of all participants shall be notified of contagious illness as soon as possible.

items.requirement: Medicine must be kept out of reach when dispensing and stored in a locked area at all other times.
items.quote: Medicine shall be kept out of the reach of the participants when dispensing and shall be stored in a locked area at all other times.

items.requirement: A first aid kit with specified contents must be kept out of reach; medication-containing kit locked.
items.quote: A first aid supply shall be kept out of reach of the participant. A first aid kit containing medications shall be locked. This kit shall include the following:

items.requirement: Smoking in an OST Program is prohibited at all times, including all areas and vehicles.
items.quote: Facilities shall comply with the Clean Indoor Air Act of 2006. Smoking in an OST Program is prohibited at all times.

items.requirement: A blanket annual parental permission may be obtained for sunscreen use.
items.quote: Sunscreen shall be used if needed and as directed by the parent. OST participants may apply sunscreen to themselves with supervision. A blanket permission may be obtained annually.

items.requirement: All staff and participants must wash hands with soap and water at specified times.
items.quote: All staff and participants shall wash their hands with soap and water at the following times:

items.requirement: There must be one toilet and one sink for each group of 30 participants.
items.quote: There shall be one (1) toilet and one (1) sink available for each group of thirty (30) participants.

items.requirement: The facility must have a written emergency plan including sheltering in place or lock down procedures.
items.quote: The Out-of-School Time (OST) Facility shall have a written plan detailing the procedures to follow in the event of emergencies (fires, floods, tornadoes, utility disruptions, bomb threats, etc.)

items.requirement: Written procedures and evacuation diagrams for emergency drills must be posted in each program space.
items.quote: Written procedures and evacuation diagrams for emergency drills shall be posted in each program space.

items.requirement: Fire and tornado drills must be practiced monthly on separate days and at different times.
items.quote: Fire and tornado drills shall be practiced as follows: a. Monthly; b. Fire and tornado drills shall be practiced on separate days and at different times of the day;

items.requirement: No alcoholic beverages during hours of care; illegal drugs or paraphernalia not allowed on premises regardless.
items.quote: There shall be no alcoholic beverages in any part of the facility during hours of care. Illegal drugs or paraphernalia shall not be in any part of the facility or on the premises, regardless if participants are present or not.

items.requirement: Transporting staff must be at least 21 (or insurance minimum), hold valid license, and complete Driver Safety training.
items.quote: Staff transporting participants shall meet the following requirements: a. Be at least twenty-one (21) years old or the minimum age required by the Licensee’s commercial auto insurance; b. Hold a current valid driver’s license

items.requirement: Swimming pool use requires 1:8 staff-to-participant ratio and certified person present.
items.quote: Adult supervision of the children shall be provided at all times, with grouping based on a 1:8 staff to participant ratio. (Unless participants are participating in an authorized swimming instruction program.)

items.requirement: Participants under 6 or under 60 lbs must be in child passenger safety seat; 6+ or 60+ lbs by safety belt.
items.quote: Any participant who is less than six (6) years old or weighs less than sixty pounds (60 lbs.) shall be restrained in a child passenger safety seat. Any participant who is at least six (6) years or weighs at least sixty pounds (60 lbs.) must be restrained by a safety belt.

items.requirement: Driver or staff must walk through and physically inspect each seat before leaving vehicle.
items.quote: To ensure that no participants are left on the vehicle, the driver or a staff member must walk through the vehicle and physically inspect each seat before leaving the vehicle.

dropped_unverified.requirement: Physical punishment shall not be administered to participants.
dropped_unverified.quote: Directed toward teaching the participant acceptable behavior and self-control. Physical punishment shall not be administered to participants.

dropped_unverified.requirement: Transportation roster must be reviewed by Director or designee and compared with attendance records; sign off.
dropped_unverified.quote: To ensure that participants have safely arrived in the appropriate program space, the transportation roster shall be reviewed by the Director or designee
